expected_semantic_oracle: Dogs category page must show Bulldog, Poodle, Dalmation, Golden Retriever, Labrador Retriever, and Chihuahua.

workflow_steps: Open welcome page; enter store; click Cats category; verify Manx and Persian.

workflow_steps: Open welcome page; enter store; click Reptiles category; verify Rattlesnake and Iguana.

workflow_steps: Enter store; open Fish category; click Angelfish product; verify Angelfish product detail page and item links.

expected_semantic_oracle: Item detail page must contain selected item information and Add to Cart option.

workflow_steps: Enter store; search for Fish; verify search results contain fish-related products.
expected_semantic_oracle: Search results must contain fish-related products and must not be empty.

workflow_steps: Enter store; search for Dog; verify search results contain dog-related products.
expected_semantic_oracle: Search results must contain dog-related products and must not be empty.

workflow_steps: Enter store; search for invalid keyword XYZNORESULT123; verify application handles no-result search correctly.

workflow_steps: Enter store; open Fish category; open Angelfish product; open an Angelfish item; click Add to Cart; verify cart contains selected Angelfish item.
expected_semantic_oracle: Shopping cart must contain the selected Angelfish item after Add to Cart.

workflow_steps: Enter store; open Dogs category; open Bulldog product; open a Bulldog item; click Add to Cart; verify cart contains selected Bulldog item.
expected_semantic_oracle: Shopping cart must contain the selected Bulldog item after Add to Cart.

workflow_steps: Add one item to cart; change quantity to 2; click Update Cart; verify quantity is updated and cart remains correct.
expected_semantic_oracle: Cart must show updated quantity as 2 and must remain on correct shopping cart page.

workflow_steps: Add one item to cart; remove the item from cart; verify item is no longer present or cart is empty.
expected_semantic_oracle: Removed item must not appear in the shopping cart.

workflow_steps: Add one item to cart; click Continue Shopping; verify user returns to catalog or shopping flow.
expected_semantic_oracle: Continue Shopping must return user to the catalog or previous shopping flow.

workflow_name: Add two items from same category
workflow_steps: Add Angelfish item to cart; return to Fish category; add Goldfish item to cart; verify both items appear in cart.
expected_semantic_oracle: Shopping cart must contain both selected fish items.

workflow_steps: Add one Fish item to cart; continue shopping; add one Dog item to cart; verify both items appear in cart.
expected_semantic_oracle: Shopping cart must contain items from both Fish and Dogs categories.

workflow_steps: Enter store; click Sign In; verify login form fields and login button are present.
expected_semantic_oracle: Sign In page must show username field password field and login control.

workflow_steps: Open Sign In page; login using valid seeded account if available; verify signed-in state is visible.
expected_semantic_oracle: After valid login the application must show signed-in state or account-specific navigation.

workflow_steps: Open Sign In page; submit invalid username and password; verify authentication failure behavior.
expected_semantic_oracle: Invalid login must not sign in and must show failure behavior or remain on Sign In page.

workflow_steps: Login with valid user; click Sign Out; verify anonymous state or Sign In link appears.
expected_semantic_oracle: After Sign Out the user must no longer be authenticated.

workflow_steps: Login with valid user; click My Account; verify account or profile page loads with account information fields.
expected_semantic_oracle: My Account page must load after login and display account information.

workflow_steps: Add item to cart; click Proceed to Checkout without login; verify application redirects to Sign In page.
expected_semantic_oracle: Checkout must require authentication and redirect unauthenticated user to Sign In page.

workflow_steps: Login with valid user; add item to cart; proceed to checkout; verify payment or order form page loads.
expected_semantic_oracle: Checkout form must load after login and cart item must be preserved.

workflow_steps: Login with valid user; add item to cart; proceed through checkout; confirm order; verify order confirmation page.
expected_semantic_oracle: Order confirmation page must be reached and must contain order confirmation details.

workflow_steps: Login with valid user; add item to cart; proceed to checkout; choose different shipping address if available; enter shipping details; confirm order.
expected_semantic_oracle: Order must use shipping address flow and reach confirmation page.

workflow_steps: Login with valid user; add two different items to cart; proceed through checkout; verify both items appear in order confirmation.
expected_semantic_oracle: Final order confirmation must include both selected items.

workflow_steps: Enter store; use left menu to open Fish Dogs Cats Reptiles and Birds one by one; verify each category page loads correctly.
expected_semantic_oracle: Each left-menu category link must navigate to the correct category page.
